description: Sri Sadguru Aadhar Foundation: senior citizen care, rehabilitation and compassionate support in Bengaluru. Visit, connect, or support our elders.
main:
OUR STORY

Rooted in care.
United by kindness.

A charity trust, a caring home, and a community that believes our elders deserve dignity.

THE HEART OF OUR FOUNDATION

Care that feels
like belonging.

Every elder deserves to be seen, heard, and cared for.

Sri Sadguru Aadhar Foundation is a charity trust and senior citizen care home in Bengaluru. We bring together compassionate support and rehabilitation, helping people live with dignity and feel connected.

Our approach puts the person first — their comfort, their independence, and the little things that make a place feel like home.

Get to know our foundation
A LITTLE KINDNESS GOES A LONG WAY

Help make their
everyday brighter.

Your support can help the foundation provide care and comfort to elders. Speak with our team about contributing funds, essentials, or your time.
